convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for SMI_Correct indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters cannot be auto-converted.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: Signal crossover triggers close of opposite side: when main crosses below signal, long positions are closed; when main crosses above signal, short positions are closed

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) serves as the lot size when LOT mode, or as the fraction in other modes.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a 2-bar crossover detection: it compares Ind[1] vs Sign[1] (previous bar relationship) and Ind[0] vs Sign[0] (current/recent bar) to detect crossover events. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to the last bar date plus one timeframe period, which is used as the signal timestamp for trade execution. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs allow independently enabling/disabling each trade direction and close action. The Recount flag forces re-evaluation on the next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The SMI_Correct custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is based on the Stochastic Momentum Index with three smoothing stages (MA_Method1 for first smoothing, MA_Method2 for second smoothing of numerator, MA_Method3 for smoothing of denominator). The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library provides JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA smoothing methods beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA - these non-standard smoothers must be ported. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory which handle money management and order execution - these must be reimplemented. Position sizing uses a MarginMode enum with 5 modes. Signal detection uses a 2-bar lookback with CopyBuffer at SignalBar offset (default bar 1). No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values.
